title: Config Stabilizer: signal fan-out, automated rollback gating, and state sync
creator: Arielle Chen
description: Build an automated stabilization layer that fans out safety signals from telemetry (cost, latency, cache-miss patterns) into a gated rollback controller and a deterministic state sync path. The system must decide when to pause, partially revert, or fully roll back config changes while guaranteeing consistent KV cache and runtime state across nodes. Focus is on safe automated responses for cost spikes caused by batching/cache regressions and preventing noisy flapping during transient anomalies.
acceptance_criteria: Controller triggers rollback proposals within 60s of a validated SLO breach or persistent cost delta above thresholds
Automated rollback honors staged traffic policies: canary -> 25% -> 0% with operator override
State snapshots taken pre-apply are restorable to a consistent cluster state without manual reconciliation
Reconciliation job produces a deterministic diff and auto-fixes up to N idempotent drift types (config flag mismatches, KV namespace renames)
Telemetry shows a >90% reduction in human interventions for config-induced cost incidents during the pilot
implementation_plan: Instrument existing config apply path to emit signed 'apply checkpoints' and pre-apply snapshots
Build a signal aggregator that computes federated cost/latency/cache metrics and derives a confidence score for rollback decisions
Implement gating service with three verdicts (no-op, suggested-rollback, immediate-rollback) and a staged execution runner
Add state-sync worker that can replay snapshot -> diff -> patch with preflight simulation mode
Integrate operator UI in Console for manual approve/abort and visibility into the staged rollback plan
Run end-to-end chaos tests in dedicated infra and a two-week pilot on low-traffic tenant pool
technical_notes: Triggers: combination of rolling 5-min cost delta > 20% vs baseline, 95th latency > SLA threshold for 3 consecutive windows, and KV cache miss-rate spike > 2x
Confidence scoring: Bayesian aggregator that downweights single-bucket anomalies; requires at least 2 independent signals to auto-initiate rollback
Safety gates: dry-run simulate on 10% traffic shadow, require snapshot validity hash match, enforce 30s hysteresis to avoid flip-flops
State snapshots: store snap metadata with immutable apply-id and checksum; snapshot format is object list (immutable metadata only) to avoid PII
Reconciliation: three-pass reconcile (detect, simulate-fix, apply) with idempotency tokens and optimistic locking
Operator override: manual priority_up flag bypasses auto-rollback for a configurable window and requires audit comment
risk_and_mitigations: False positives causing unnecessary rollbacks: mitigate with multi-signal confidence and dry-run shadow execution
Partial state restores can leave nodes inconsistent: enforce snapshot checksum and a quorum-based coordinator for apply-phase
Operator confusion about automated actions: provide clear Console timeline view and immediate Slack alerts with runbook links
Performance impact of additional snapshots: keep snapshot metadata minimal and TTL snapshots to 24h for pilot
metrics_to_monitor: Post-rollback success rate (no follow-up manual fixes)
Delta in cost-per-token for affected routes after stabilization
updates: 2025-03-25: Kickoff - scoped MVP: signal aggregator, gating service, snapshot store, and Console panel. Owner: Mateo.
2025-03-28: Decided on multi-signal confidence threshold approach; removed single-signal autosubmit to reduce FP risk.
2025-03-31: Prototype of snapshot format merged to runtime repo (PR 7892). Initial perf tests show 3% CPU tail increase; acceptable for pilot.
2025-04-02: Integration test uncovered race when applying staged rollback during leader failover; added optimistic locking step to state-sync worker. Assigned follow-up ENG-77501.
next_steps: Finish gating service endpoints and wire to Console for visibility
Complete reconciliation worker's 2nd pass (simulate-fix) and add idempotency tests
Schedule pilot deployment to 'alpha-tenants' and run the chaos plan
Coordinate security review with Compliance team before enabling auto-rollback on P0 tenants
